read_only_frequency_counts.method: Stream the exact already-authorised C2 source artifact, project C2_LEVEL/C2_CONTAINER only, group by side/source kind and exact geometry_signature, and count exact-geometry frequencies. No Candidate-Tracklet-ObjectAssertion semantic runtime was invoked.

strict_lower_bound.derivation: For Candidate A, an exact geometry occurring at most twice cannot reach CONFIRMATION_COUNT=3 and therefore cannot form a confirmed assertion. With no discontinuity/terminal-break arguments supplied by the R3 candidate child, its tracklet remains open. Considering only the first occurrence of each such persistent geometry, each later first occurrence in the same hard scope must be compared with every earlier persistent open tracklet in that scope. This yields sum over hard scopes of M*(M-1)/2 comparisons before counting second occurrences, frequency>=3 geometries, assertions, or any other competitor evidence.

interpretation: The current full-cardinality capacity qualification, which produced about one evidence vector per synthetic candidate and only two terminal tracklets/two assertions, does not bound the logical evidence volume implied by the real Candidate A source shape. If the bounded synthetic scaling harness confirms the frozen N*(N-1)/2 mechanism, physical SQLite compaction or a small storage-ceiling increase cannot lawfully resolve the blocker without a separately governed semantic/runtime scalability design decision.
